paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: : LLaMA-2-7B
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the informativeness of LLaMA-2-7B on longer math word problems, comparing two configurations: “w.o. extension” (without extension) and “extension”. The x-axis, labeled with integer values from 0 to 4, represents the problem length or step index, while the y-axis, labeled “Informativeness”, ranges from 0.920 to 0.970 and is scaled linearly. The “w.o. extension” condition is depicted by a blue dashed line with circular markers, starting at approximately 0.968 at x=0 and decreasing steadily to 0.920 at x=4. The “extension” condition is shown by an orange solid line with triangular markers, beginning at approximately 0.968 at x=0 and declining to 0.918 at x=4. Both lines exhibit a consistent downward trend, with the “extension” line slightly below the “w.o. extension” line at x=2 and x=4, indicating marginally lower informativeness when the extension is applied at those points.
